clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Vile Familiars are creeping out of a nearby cavern. Zureetha Fargaze found a hidden Burning Blade coven while watching over the valley's trials. Recruits are sent to hunt the familiars spreading across Durotar's red earth.

The Valley of Trials tests young orcs and Darkspear trolls in strength, discipline, and loyalty to Thrall's Horde. Its trials were meant to pit recruits against scorpids and boars, not demonic corruption. Yet a cave to the northeast shelters agents of the Burning Blade, who have formed a secret coven beneath the valley overseers' watch.

Zureetha Fargaze, an instructor guiding newcomers near the Den, spotted the taint before it could overrun the canyon. Vile Familiars now pour from the cave mouth, hurling fire at anyone who wanders too close. Before the Horde can root out the masters in hiding, young recruits are sent to cut down these lesser servants and keep the valley secure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I trust the Valley of Trials will teach you much, young adventurer.
I was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...

A group that calls itself the Burning Blade has a coven here in the Valley of Trials. They are skulking in a cave to the northeast, and their Vile Familiars have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.
As your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: To prove yourself against the Burning Blade, you must first defeat its Vile Familiars. Return to me when you have done this.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Although the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
